chapter: Brass bands and the ERA/WPA band
title: The St. John lodge brass band and its members
summary: He describes the St. John lodge brass band during the Depression and its members, including Dave, Richardson and Buster Moore.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh, I started to ask about the brass bands. We might finish that up first. Okay. It's a smaller picture. Which bands have you played with? I suppose a lot of them maybe didn't even have names, you know, but I mean in the brass bands on the street.

Well, I'll tell you how that go. I played with the St. John Band. That was back about in 19, St. John. Let me see exactly. St. John Band. St. John Band was around about in, St. John Band was around about 37. Yeah, St. John. No, that was the name of the society. They had a lodge at the St. John Lodge. They had a band. They had went and bought a lot of instruments for the teaching. And the fellas that couldn't learn. They put a lot of money. But the fellas that had instruments went on and kept the band up because they had a lot
of work. And we'd go everywhere with the lodge.

And where the lodge went that we would go. That was at the same time as the ERA Band. That was the same time during the Depression. We had the St. John Band too. Yeah. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Yeah. Well this St. John Band now it was a brass band. It was a brass band. It was a brass band. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. This St. John Band now was a brass band?
Did you have about the same lineup as they have now in the brass band? Like two, three saxes? What was the lineup?

Well, you had the sax, drum, trombone, bass. Now at that time when we had the St. John Band, now that was before Richardson went with the URIC. We had Richardson with us. Oh yeah. We had a fella by the name of Baptiste, he's in that playing, well Dave was with us, with the St. John Band.

Yeah, he was in the St. John Band. And we had this boy Adam Page, he was in the St. John Band. Buster, he was in the St. John Band. Buster Moore? Yeah, Buster Moore. But then when the war come, well they all spit from the St. John and so forth like that. And after that, well the St. John went on and then the spill took some of the remaining, it was from the St. John and he organized.
Oh, I see. It was from the St. John and it went into the Gibson Band?

Well, some of the men, like Dave was there. Dave was there. Yeah, Dave was one of the original men from the St. John Band. Now Dave and Richardson, about the two oldest men and I think Cal, yeah them three about the oldest men from the St. John Band. Yeah, but the rest of the fellas are all newcomers. Uh-huh. Yeah.
